summary: Hudson told WCMU in 2024 he would vote against the February 2024 border bill for bundling too much Ukraine and Israel funding, while still supporting U.S. aid to Israel's defense. His documented position on the conflict centers on continued American military assistance to Israel; the vote against the bill reflected a funding-level objection to the package rather than opposition to Israel aid itself.
